files.explanation: INPUT_SEAL.json here seals the staged E13a input bank (causal.input.json, items.input.jsonl, ... as staged from the W-core cache e13a-stage-v1/bank/). Its manifest.json entry is that bank's manifest, which is byte-identical to W1b's frozen bank manifest (local_sha256 above; committed at results/g_agreement/blindspot/w1b/freeze/manifest.json in W-core local commit 328bc63c, published there with one machine path replaced; see results/g_agreement/blindspot/w1b/freeze/REDACTION_NOTE.json). The committed results/g_agreement/understand/e13a/manifest.json is a different file (E13a's run manifest) that shares the name, so it was never covered by this seal entry. No redaction was involved.

notes.what: Seal no longer verifies on the published branch because machine paths in the sealed file were replaced (absolute local paths by repo-relative or placeholder paths) when it was published. local_sha256 is the sealed hash; the original is at local_commit in the owner's local history, or (local_file) in the owner's worktree or its git-ignored cache. Each redaction gives the line, the published replacement span and the original span's sha256/length; restoring the original spans reproduces local_sha256 exactly (checked when this note was written). No score, seal or verdict changed.
